budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Elementary fire alarm project (ARPA gap)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: No surplus remained to cover a shortfall on the Turkey Hill fire alarm project plus engineering and contingency costs.
budget_items.quote: no surplus funds remained to cover a $62,000 shortfall on the turkey hill elementary school fire alarm project, plus up to $25,000 in engineering and contingency costs

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Gap closed by an internal capital transfer and additional unallocated ARPA funds; about $13,000 left toward engineering and contingency.
budget_items.quote: the town transferred approximately $20,000 in unused capital funds internally to turkey hill and identified an additional $75,000 in unallocated arpa funds

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total cost estimate targeted at about $15 million at a $600 per square foot assumption, before elevator and specialized costs.
budget_items.quote: the total cost estimate remains targeted at approximately $15 million, with a cost assumption of $600 per square foot

budget_items.what_was_recorded: 2022 estimate for a standalone PAC building shell, excluding interior buildout.
budget_items.quote: cost estimates from 2022 placed such a building at approximately $1.5-2 million for the shell alone, not including interior buildout

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Enterprise fund reserves earmarked for interior buildout; PAC said standalone operation would strain the fund.
budget_items.quote: has reserves of approximately $900,000 earmarked for interior buildout

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fund invested, generating about $36,000 in its first year; franchise fees declining.
budget_items.quote: the enterprise fund has been invested, generating approximately $36,000 in its first year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Franchise fees that fund PAC are declining each year.
budget_items.quote: franchise fees are declining at approximately 3-4% annually

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident objected to spending up to $2 million on a separate PAC facility.
budget_items.quote: rather than spending up to $2 million on a separate facility

budget_items.topic: Comparison communities: tax bills and income
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Removal of communities based on median income and average single-family tax bills.
budget_items.quote: concord, with a tax bill of $19,104 and an affordability ratio of approximately 9%

budget_items.quote: an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $2,779,248.28 was signed by vice-chair jeffreys and member alonzo

transfers.description: Internal transfer of unused capital funds to the Turkey Hill fire alarm project, plus $75,000 in unallocated ARPA funds identified to close the gap.
transfers.outcome: Reported as done by the Interim Town Manager; no vote recorded.
transfers.quote: the town transferred approximately $20,000 in unused capital funds internally to turkey hill and identified an additional $75,000 in unallocated arpa funds

transfers.description: Previously set-aside ARPA administrative funds applied to existing salaries, unused balances frozen rather than a continuity plan written.
transfers.outcome: Decided by the Interim Town Manager; balances frozen so they can be reversed once the new Town Manager's contract is final.
